title: Simultaneous K-injective resolutions for a filtered complex and all its filtration subquotients

standard_prerequisites.use: Grothendieck abelian categories, functorial unboundedK-injective resolutions, cones and homotopies, products ofK-injectives and split exact sequences. The local derived-product argument is retained.

core_obligations: Starting from functorialK-injective resolutions, construct acyclic auxiliary embeddings and compatible nullhomotopy extensions to make a genuine injective filtration.
Prove that the resulting total complex, every filtration piece, quotient and subquotient isK-injective and that all corresponding comparison maps are quasi-isomorphisms.

proof_roadmap.step: Starting from functorialK-injective resolutions, construct acyclic auxiliary embeddings and compatible nullhomotopy extensions to make a genuine injective filtration.
Prove that the resulting total complex, every filtration piece, quotient and subquotient isK-injective and that all corresponding comparison maps are quasi-isomorphisms.

difficulty_reason: Resolving each filtration piece separately does not preserve monomorphisms or compatibility. The auxiliary acyclic product construction simultaneously repairs this for all subquotients, giving a concrete H2 resolution problem.
